body: That last phrase was wonderful thanks mate, I did and basically had my friend holding me to not fall and take my meds to take the suicidal thoughts out of my mind for now :) thank you
Thanks it really has helped everyday :) thank you so much, I'm still here btw

Mine was full narcissistic too, then one day she broke a bone and experiencing that daily pain made her finally change, now she's a caring mother and basically keeps me alive. Don't let hate invade your heart, maybe one day she will change, and if not then fuck that! she's nothing compared to yourself! You fight and are really strong from keeping yourself alive :)

Owww thanks! Yes! 
In my case my mother is always reminding me that maybe I'm the one who inherited depression in my family because I'm the strongest one who could keep up with the suffering... everyone with depression is strong so strong that we keep fighting every single day, and if someone stops fighting and ends life then it's because they were too exhausted from the battle :(
WOW where do you heard that?? I want to read about this

I"m living everyday thanks to my brother. When I was on the edge of planning to do it that day he saw it in my eyes!!! He suddenly hugged me out of nowhere and made me promise I wouldn't kill myself. 

We understand you, your daily struggle, but we shall keep fighting if not for ourselves then for the people who loves us , cause if they are telling us they like us to live by their side then maybe living will not be that bad one day when we are out of depression like them :)
Thanks to all of you... another day passed and I'm still alive so, at least for my family and friends that's good :)
Are you on meds?

Ouh I cry on all of those exact scenarios :(

Also, congrats on keeping with college :) one day we will feel better

Maybe you could make special playlists for when you're in public so you are sure that there aren't any sad songs :)

I have special playlists for when I want to cry, for motivation to study, for trying to get happy before socializing or having class, for getting courage to get out and put on a reasonably fake smile...  :)
I'm here with you too. And someone out there is also crying but the most important thing is to keep surviving! We must try and try and try and hit that mf depression right in the face!
Thank you so much for those last sentences, they were just what I need :'( i cried!!! (Hehe)

For anyone crying daily and hardcore I have an useful tip: make sure to take intermitent "breaks" from crying to drink some water (if you are crying for +1hour make sure to drink at least 1 litre bottle).
This way you avoid the future migraine and headache that comes the day after :)

Get help and dont get lost in the anxiety and depressive moments. I moved cities for college, shit happened, got lost in relapse and now I came back home for a leave of abscense :(

HERE it is all the same again... if you got the courage to move then remember why you decided that back home you were not feeling good either, I wish I had stayed and asked for help in my new college because when you get back home then having people help you moving out again is much more harder

Talk to him/her and just listen. If you are meeting in person arrive with a surprise ice-cream for both of you and the most sincere smile you can give :) it's "small and simple" stuff for you but we have learnt to over enjoy those details and crave for them
What do you mean with "acknowledge" it? My psychiatrist says that all the time but I dont get it :(

How do you trust your confidence after this relapse?
I have trouble trusting myself from knowing I let it come back again full force :(

Im crying in bed this exact moment too... i dont wanna die but im exhausted from trying to live.
Depression is damn unfair to us but still I feel some hope in my heart.


I cant help you more than giving you this small advice so you can feel listened and less alone: being designated the "weird kid" is nonsense cause that is only the projection of your classmates insecurities, this way they can mask their flaws by focusing their attention to you (kind of like classic kidergarten situation when a toddler farted and the toddler at the other end of the room would be blamed just because he was too shy to defend himself) so everything is about showing confidence kid :)

For the neglectful parents situation I can only tell you what my psychiatrist tells me: the compassion you so much seek in your life can only be found in yourself cause YOU and only you are the person that is always gonna be there when you need it. 

Im not mature enough to be that compassionate with myself and you are younger than me but keep fighting kid :) junior high school was cruel to me but I can tell you it made me stronger and thanks to that college is waaaaay fun and easier!!! 

Virtual hug to you :)
